metadesc: Learn how to view, edit, and delete room type configurations in vcms.io. Discover how to manage Twin and Standard rooms, add new options, modify settings, and handle unsaved changes efficiently.

hotspots.text: Open the room type you want to move rooms out of.
Please press the X button to reduce the number of rooms.
Pressing the save button reduces the number of rooms of that room type. You can move that many rooms into other room types.
Please select the room type to add.
You can add as many rooms as you want. If the total number of rooms currently paid for is exceeded, additional payment is required.
Once you have finished adding the room, please press the save button.

title: Moving a room to another room type
